title: Mekanism Chemical Stabilized Consumption Upgrade
description: A Mekanism addon that add a upgrade can make chemical consumption stabilized!
body:
This is a Mekanism addon that adds an upgrade to stabilize chemical consumption!

By default, chemical injectors, purification chambers, and chemical dissolution chambers consume a semi-randomized amount of chemical per operation, and this upgrade makes that amount fixed for every operation, just like the Osmium Compressor.

Support Mekanism Extras、Mekanism: More Machine、Evolved Mekanism 、 Evolved Mekanism Extras.

Affected machines:

*   Chemical Dissolution Chamber
*   Chemical Injection Chamber
*   Purification Chamber
*   Planting Station (mekmm)
